A set of orders

Source: R/classes.R
dp_orders.Rd

A dp_orders object is a tibble with one row per order, subclassed so that format() renders it back to standard notation. Build one with dp_order(), dp_parse_orders() or dp_legal_orders().

Details

The columns are power, type (one of "hold", "move", "support", "convoy", "retreat", "build", "disband", "waive"), unit_type, loc, target, aux_type, aux_loc, aux_target and via_convoy. The aux_* columns describe the order being supported or convoyed. After adjudication the tibble gains a success column and a note explaining anything the rules changed.

See also

dp_order(), dp_parse_orders(), format.dp_orders()

Other orders: as_tibble.dp_orders(), dp_bind_orders(), dp_example_orders(), dp_legal_orders(), dp_order(), dp_parse_orders(), format.dp_orders(), is_dp_orders()

Examples

o <- dp_parse_orders("France: A Par - Bur")
names(o)
#> [1] "power"      "type"       "unit_type"  "loc"        "target"    
#> [6] "aux_type"   "aux_loc"    "aux_target" "via_convoy"
